name: attr-commondir-t1985-late
cmd: set -e; D={cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1; for spec in 'ctrl_s1|{cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1_late|{outroot}/E025/late-caches-c56919f15da8/t1985s1/desk_late|desk_tempho_1985_seed1|none' 'statT_s1|{cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1_statT_late|{outroot}/E038/desk-tempho1985-seed1-statT-0de857c2b8e1/late/desk_late|desk_tempho_1985_seed1|{outroot}/E038/desk-tempho1985-seed1-statT-0de857c2b8e1/static_means.npy' 'ctrl_s2|{cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s2_late|{outroot}/E025/late-caches-c56919f15da8/t1985s2/desk_late|desk_tempho_1985_seed2|none' 'statT_s2|{cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s2_statT_late|{outroot}/E038/desk-tempho1985-seed2-statT-dee3cbeac21f/late/desk_late|desk_tempho_1985_seed2|{outroot}/E038/desk-tempho1985-seed2-statT-dee3cbeac21f/static_means.npy'; do IFS='|' read -r tag cc run ov means <<< "$spec"; A="research/exp/backcast_attribution.py --cache $cc --run-dir $run --overlay research/overlays/$ov.json --out {out}/$tag --families --luh-split --dir-cache $D"; if [ "$means" = none ]; then {python} $A; else {python} research/exp/static_channels.py --channels temperature --means-cache $means -- $A; fi; done
summarize: for d in {out}/*/; do {python} research/exp/backcast_attribution.py --summarize $d; done
note: E038b: attribution on ONE analog direction (the control's dynamic covariates), T0 1985, late state, controls and static-temperature models
